source: office5 report notes + hand-written thin notes

checklist.text: Fire walls and separations, and whether openings in them are protected
Generators or UPS, what they serve and how they are tested
Each boiler's type, fuel and pressure, where it sits and how it is separated, and its combustion safeguards and inspection records
Fuels on site (gas, oil, LPG), how much is stored and where, and their emergency shut-offs
Refrigeration plant and its refrigerant, chillers, and cooling towers with their construction and whether combustible fill is protected
Each transformer's type, rating, oil or dry type, and separation from buildings
Sprinkler system types, coverage and design density for each area
Each fire pump's type, driver, rating and controller
Where alarms are monitored, and how quickly they are acted on
Water sources, tanks and mains feeding the fire protection
Check server and comms rooms: separation, detection and suppression

observations.note: addressable fire alarm, monitored 24/7 by FCC on L1, direct link to SCDF. hose reels + extinguishers every floor, wet riser
wet pipe sprinklers throughout incl car park, OH1 office / OH2 carpark. sprinkler tanks B3 2 x 300 m3. jockey + duty elec + standby diesel pump
tenant server room L5, approx 40 racks. UPS room next door, VRLA batteries. diesel genset at roof, 2 x 2000 kVA, day tank 1000 L, tested monthly on load per FM

so the office floors are open plan, no separation within a floor except the utility rooms. elec rooms are 2 hour walls and floors with 2 hour doors, and every elec room we went into had the cable penetrations sealed
3 x water cooled chillers B3, cooling towers on roof. 22 kV incomer from SP, 2 x transformers B1. no boilers. no hazardous storage apart from genset diesel
